author: Khalil ouerfelli

title: Privacy is key
content: Great app. My favorite part is I own the data. It’s not being shipped off to some external server. I control its release.
author: pilotinprogress

title: Sleek app
content: This app looks amazing and is feature packed at a great price. I have been testing it against mileIQ and Everlance as I have recently started a new job with a lot more business mileage and needed an app to help me track those work related miles. Magica is a much better price but could improve a little bit in the ease of classification of trips to be more like Everlance and MileIQ’s swipe to classify feature. I emailed the app creator and gave him my thoughts. He was amazingly responsive, asked some questions to better understand my feedback and immediately went about trying to develop some improvements based on some of that feedback. I’ll continue to use Magica and hope to see the improvements in convenient trip classification soon! Thanks Dimitri for making this app and trying to meet the needs of your customers!
author: smash ngrab

title: Perfect for EV’s
content: This is the only mileage tracker that works with EVs. The refill/recharge supports EV charging so you can track easily when you need to recharge again. The reporting is very clear, supports maintenance records and multiple vehicles.
author: JiiiimT

title: Constant GPS use
content: Always-on GPS. I have automated tracking on when I connect to Bluetooth, so the app should not be tracking my movement when it’s not connected to my car. It’s almost always reporting my location—privacy issues aside, this is a massive drain on the battery. There is no reason it should be requesting my location, yet it is. I purchased this app because it seemed well-suited for my purposes but I cannot recommend this app.
author: Army2949

title: Used to be great
content: Ugh.  I used this app solely for my side business to track trips using manual mode in car play. After the latest update, it is forcing me to turn location tracking always on. So now I need to nope right out of the app and find a new one.
author: DallasAppGuy

title: Faulty odometer reading
content: Really slick app that integrates with CarPlay to get really detailed stats. Only issue I have is the odometer reading is off. For some reason the app keeps adding 14000 miles to my odometer after a refueling and I’m not sure why.
author: EdKensington

title: Does almost everything
content: I haven’t found a mileage tracking app as well designed and as polished as this one. Huge thank you to the developer. There is one problem though, when using CarPlay, it seems to force an active trip no matter how many times I try to enable manual mode. Otherwise, it’s fantastic. I like the LiveActivites integration and detailed trip screens, they are very nice touches

title: Great and complete app
content:
I used many mileage tracker apps but this is the best one.
You can add the data manually or have it all done automatically.
Lots of statistics that can be downloaded in any format.
